packet.scope: Use its already admitted complete paragraph records only. No source TSV, image, reserve, absent RF paragraph, alternative source or newly assembled span may be fetched.

families.basis: r explicitly has the exact copular denotation of qoky.
okedy explicitly has the same food-kind L denotation as qokain.
san explicitly has the same food-kind-to-nourishment-profile denotation as saiiin.
All four explicitly share propositional negation before argument application. The propositions negated may differ; the rule tracks lexical-denotation recurrence, not repeated propositions.
Both explicitly denote the same food-kind T.
y explicitly denotes the same source-present community G at tau0 as ysheeyqorar.

scoring_readers: Only readers meeting every capacity gate; failed readers retain full census and are not scored; RF empty is explicit missing data. RNG traverses capacity-passing readers in listed order and their mobile blocks in sorted order each world. No score if none passes.
block_order: paragraph_id, family array index, edge class lexicographically, prev_dy bool, current_dy bool
uncertainty: all lines anchor_eligible exactly true; otherwise entire paragraph source uncertain, no payload-derived ranks or scores
claim_ceiling: Conditional fixed spelling model only; no independent meaning, anaphora, source identification, significance of whole search, or reserve confirmation.
